body: Library module github.com/ubgo/dotenv at the repo root; CLI module github.com/ubgo/dotenv/cli, installed with go install github.com/ubgo/dotenv/cli/cmd/dotenvctl@<version>. Library tags are vX.Y.Z, CLI tags are cli/vX.Y.Z (Go's nested-module tag convention). A go.work at the root lets cli build against the sibling library without a replace directive; the cli's go.mod pins a published library version so go install works.
title: Module paths: github.com/ubgo/dotenv (library) and github.com/ubgo/dotenv/cli (CLI)
